window_training_semantics.1_window_sampling_mechanism: Implemented in dmg.core.data.data.random_index and select_subset. Slices [warmup + rho, batch_size, features] tensor by choosing i_grid and i_t per batch item.
window_training_semantics.2_start_date_randomization: True. i_t = np.random.randint(warmup, nt - rho, size=batch_size) chooses an independent random time index for each sample in the mini-batch.
window_training_semantics.3_basin_randomization: True. i_grid = np.random.randint(0, ngrid, size=batch_size) chooses an independent random basin index for each sample in the mini-batch.
window_training_semantics.4_batch_organization: Multiple independent (basin_k, time_window_k) pairs. Sample k has its own basin i_grid[k] and time slice [i_t[k] - warmup, i_t[k] + rho).

5_warmup_365_days_semantics.mode_a_warmup_no_grad: In hydrodl2.models.hbv.hbv_1_1p with warmup_states=True, the first warmup days (e.g. 365) are executed under with torch.no_grad(): to spin up physical storage states without retaining the autograd graph.
5_warmup_365_days_semantics.mode_b_full_graph_with_trim: In dmg.models.model_handler.ModelHandler._trim, the model runs all 730 days in the autograd graph, and output[warmup:] / target[warmup:] are sliced before loss calculation.
5_warmup_365_days_semantics.loss_on_warmup: False. In all modes, warmup period timesteps are excluded from loss computation.

window_training_semantics.6_scored_365_days_loss_masking: Loss is calculated solely on the scored period (last rho=365 days). Missing observations (NaNs) are filtered via torch.isnan / isfinite boolean masks inside the criterion classes (NseBatchLoss, KgeBatchLoss, MSELoss).
window_training_semantics.7_epoch_coverage_definition: An epoch is defined by n_iter_ep = ceil(log(0.01) / log(1 - batch_size * rho / (n_samples * (n_t - warmup)))) random mini-batches, guaranteeing ~99% coverage of the (basin, time) space.
window_training_semantics.8_validation_test_semantics: Inference and testing run on the complete continuous time series (eval mode with torch.no_grad()) across all evaluation basins, not random window sampling.
